info.title: Audio Note
info.description: Speak to a wiki page. A recording already stored in the site's assets (through the Farm plugin's assets upload) is transcribed on this farm with faster-whisper, and the transcript can be summarised by Claude through a prompt — usually one drawn from a prompt wiki. The recorder and the Voice Tool page use these; so can an agent.

post.summary: Transcribe a recording in this site's assets
post.description: Queues faster-whisper over assets/<slug>/<filename> and answers at once with a job to poll. Writes <name>.whisper.json and <name>.txt beside the recording.

slug.description: The page whose asset folder holds the recording.

filename.description: The recording's file name in that folder.

model.description: Whisper model: tiny.en, base.en or small.en (and the multilingual tiny, base, small). Default set by the farm.

200.description: The job id, and how many are ahead of it.

get.summary: How a transcription is getting on

200.description: state is queued, running, done or failed; engine and host say where it runs; when done, provider, model, text, segments and the sidecar paths.

404.description: No such job at this site.

post.summary: Summarise a transcript through a prompt (Claude, the coop, Ollama, or auto)
post.description: Fills the prompt's {{transcript}}, {{page_title}}, {{page_text}} and {{date}} and asks Claude. Spends money, so it is gated like a write.

pageText.description: The page's text, for prompts that answer it.

title.description: The title the result will be saved under, often one of the page's red links; prompts read it as {{title}}.

prompt.description: The prompt body, after its header. Omitted, a plain summary prompt is used.

model.description: claude-<id> for the Claude API, claude-cli:claude-<id> for the Claude Code CLI under the account logged in on the farm machine (a Max subscription, no API key), ollama:<name> for an Ollama model, openai:<name> for a model behind the coop's OpenAI-compatible door, or auto to let the farm pick per summary by the question's size: Claude Fable 5.1 over AUDIONOTE_AUTO_BIG_TOKENS (48k), else the coop's own routing (llm_auto-big), and Claude when the coop is down; the pick and its reason come back as `auto`. Default CLAUDE_DOOR_MODEL (AUDIONOTE_SUMMARY_MODEL), else claude-opus-5; CLAUDE_DOOR_FALLBACK_MODEL (AUDIONOTE_FALLBACK_MODEL) is tried when the first cannot be reached.

200.description: markdown, the model that wrote it, and for auto the pick and its reason.

503.description: No API key on this farm.

post.summary: Transcribe a recording without keeping it
post.description: The request body is the recording itself. It is transcribed from the farm's temporary folder and then deleted — nothing is added to the site's assets. Answers at once with a job to poll; the finished job carries the text and segments, which engine heard it (macwhisper where the MacWhisper app is running on the farm's machine, else faster-whisper) and the machine's host name. To keep the audio, upload it separately through the Farm plugin's assets upload. Gated on the place alone: a private farm answers any caller, so a browser on a laptop can send a recording to the laptop's own farm — the local door — instead of the farm serving the page; it changes no page and keeps nothing.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Whisper model: tiny.en, base.en or small.en (and the multilingual tiny, base, small).

200.description: The job id, and how many are ahead of it.

post.summary: Ask a model about the question being answered: tell me more, research it, or the author's own question
post.description: Puts one question to a model with the question's context: the lines of the page where it is asked, the page's text, related pages the farm's search found (their text sent by the browser) and anything said so far. kind 'research' lets Claude read the web (WebSearch, WebFetch) when the farm reaches Claude by the CLI; other doors answer from the pages alone and the answer says web: false. Spends money, so it is gated like a write.

question.description: The question being answered — the Voice Tool's page title, often a red link.

kind.description: more = tell me more (default); research = research this question; own = the author's own question in `ask`.

ask.description: The author's own question, for kind own.

pageText.description: The text of the page the question is asked on.

context.description: The items of that page that mention the question, with the heading above them.

related.description: Pages like the question, from the farm's search: {title, site, slug, synopsis, text}.

transcript.description: What has been said so far, when there is a transcript.

model.description: As for summarise: a model id, or auto.

200.description: markdown, the model that wrote it, kind, web (whether the web was read), and for auto the pick.

400.description: No question, or kind own with nothing typed.
